biography:
I am a results-driven leader with over 24 years of experience in the energy and industrial sectors, specializing in strategic development and capital project execution. As an Executive of Capital Development, I leverage my extensive expertise in managing the design, construction, and optimization of complex projects, including power generation facilities, utility infrastructure, and advanced manufacturing plants.

Throughout my career, I have successfully led multi-billion-dollar projects, driving innovation and operational excellence in diverse industries. My hands-on experience spans land acquisition, feasibility studies, environmental permitting, engineering management, and project execution. These experiences have honed my ability to navigate the technical and regulatory complexities of the energy sector while delivering projects safely, efficiently, and within budget.

I thrive in building and leading high-performing teams, aligning strategic objectives with client goals, and fostering collaborative environments to achieve outstanding results. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from North Carolina A&T State University and an MBA in Finance from Morgan State University. I am also a certified Project Management Professional (PMP) and am based in Dallas, TX.

Passionate about sustainability and innovation, I am committed to advancing the mission to deliver energy-efficient, resilient, and sustainable solutions. Let's connect to collaborate on transformative projects and drive meaningful impact in the energy and industrial sectors.
